firstStep: Trader Minaless, who grows herbs on the side, has recently been growing a flower called nightshade. This plant requires a special fertilizer known as zombie dust. You must have zombie skin in order to create zombie dust. Trader Minaless asks you to go to the Marshlands south of the Dark Forest, slay the marsh zombies and bring back five zombie skins.

title: Bones Tell the Future
intro: Tetrarch Kaitar predicts the future with dead men's bones. He foresees an approaching darkness that threatens to destroy all the races! He needs a secret ingredient containing awesome death energy to fully understand the prophecy...
firstStep: Tetrarch Kaitar tells the future by throwing the bones of the undead. He performs a monthly reading to predict any imminent threat to the Dark Elves. He needs more bone fragments of the undead and asks you to go and collect 10 of them for him. You can obtain them by going to the School of Dark Arts and slaying skeletons.

title: Sweetest Venom
intro: Dark Elves are very fond of drevient wine, a drink made from the venom of spiders. Astaron, a master brewer, offers to make some for you if you'll bring him the ingredients he needs.
firstStep: Astaron explains that dreviant wine is brewed from spider venom. He wants to use grapes imported from Gludio a while back by Trader Vollodos. He asks that you obtain 10 spider venom sacs which are the most difficult to find among the ingredients he needs. Hunt spiders in the Dark Forest and return the sacs to Astaron for a reward. Hunt poison spiders...

title: Grim Collector
intro: Legend says that there is someone who collects bits and pieces of undead things... What could he be thinking?
firstStep: While discussing the ruins, Guard Curtis speaks of some good work and tells you about Samed. Visit Samed and talk about Curtis. You'll be asked to run an errand.

title: Vanquish Remnants
intro: The Black Lion Mercenaries are seeking volunteers to help rid the kingdom of the last of the filthy Gracian invaders! After their humiliating defeat, most of the Gracians returned home, but a few stragglers stayed behind to loot and pillage. Stand with the Black Lion against the filthy invaders!
firstStep: The Black Lion Mercenaries, hired by the Lord of Gludio to dispose of the ol mahums, have performed very poorly. Having suffered massive losses, they are recruiting skilled fighters to join their battle against the ol mahums. Defeat the ol mahums and collect their badges as proof. Leopold will reward you. Monsters to Hunt - Ol Mahum patrols, Ol Mahum...

title: Recover the Farmland
intro: All that awaited the farmers returning home from the long war was burned land and evil barbarians!
firstStep: Turek Orcs have infested the previously fertile farmland northwest of Gludio. On behalf of the farmers of Gludio, Farmer Piotur is recruiting mercenaries to drive out the Orcs from their stolen farmland. Slay the Turek Orcs, collect the proofs and take them to Piotur. He will give you a reward.

title: Sense for Business
intro: Legends speak of a hidden treasure in the Wastelands... How could such a desolate place hold treasure?
firstStep: Trader Sarien sells rare magical ingredients to the Ivory Tower of Oren. He tells you that you can acquire monster eye meat and jade in the Wastelandss. He also asks you to retrieve a monster eye carcass and a basilisk's gizzard. Monster to be hunted

title: Curiosity of a Dwarf
intro: Dwarves are naturally curious, but Rolento is even more curious than most! He's looking for some like-minded individuals to join him...
firstStep: Dwarven Trader Rolento is interested in studying the internal structure and activation methods of golems. He's especially interested in their power source, and asks you to obtain a piece of stone that is known as "Heart Stone." It can be obtained from granite golems or punchers. Monsters to Hunt - punchers and granite golems.

title: Adept of Taste
intro: Chef Jonas' dream has always been to return to his hometown a world-class chef. He plans to enter a royal competition, which will be judged by none other than Magister Mirien, a notoriously finicky eater!... What ever shall he prepare...?
firstStep: Chef Jonas is preparing a monster eye steak for a competition. The judge is Magister Mirien, also known as the 'Adept of Taste'. You must collect the highest-quality ingredients in order to satisfy her.

title: Arrow of Vengeance
intro: The land dragon Antharas has been ravaging the kingdom of Aden for the past several years. There is one person in particular who seeks to avenge his tyranny...
firstStep: Guard Belton burns for revenge after losing his family to the land dragon, antharas. He is making a special arrow of harpy feather, medusa venom, and wyrm's tooth in order to slay the dragon. He asks you to help him collect the ingredients. Monster to

title: Hunt of the Black Lion
intro: Evil spirits have taken advantage of Aden's weakness after the Gracian War to wreak havoc all over the kingdom. The Lords from each territory have called upon the Black Lion Mercenaries to drive the evil spirits away...
firstStep: Sophya, the captain of the Black Lion Mercenaries, asks that you help to rid the Town of Dion of monsters. Eliminate the undead on the Execution Grounds, the Ol Mahums in the Fortress of Resistance, the Delu Lizardmen on the southern shores and the Marsh Stakato in the Cruma Marshlands.

title: The Wishing Potion
intro: Alchemist Matild has long tried to create a mysterious potion. She recently discovered a book containing the recipe and asks you to bring it to her. She gives you a book of alchemy and gives you directions to the secret keeper tree.
firstStep: Alchemist Matild has long wished to create a mysterious potion. She has recently discovered its recipe and asks you to bring the ingredients to her. She gives you a book of alchemy, along with directions to the ingredients for the mysterious potion. Find the secret keeper tree.

title: Song of the Hunter
intro: The Hunters Guild has a long, romantic history, and has always been in the dreams of youths who seek adventure... Whether they choose to hunt criminals or monsters! It's definitely not an easy task to join the Hunters Guild.
firstStep: Grey of the Hunters Union tells you about the union and says that in order to join, you must pass a test to obtain a hunter's license. Bring back three or more of the items listed on the test to receive a circle 1 hunter's license. Those in possession of such a license may carry out various missions for the guild.

title: Coins of Magic
intro: Who would have thought that coin collecting could lead to such horrific chaos throughout the kingdom? It seems impossible to control now! Can you get the Coin Collector Membership 1?
firstStep: Coin Collector Warehouse Keeper Sorint asks you to meet with Hunters Union President Bernard and retrieve the golden dragon of Kaldis.

title: Audience with the Land Dragon
intro: The land dragon Antharas has rampaged throughout the entire kingdom of Giran since he awoke from his ancient slumber. Gabrielle is looking for a warrior to rid the land of this scourge.
firstStep: The quest to obtain the portal stone, needed to enter Antharas' Lair. Seal Watchman Gabrielle warns that Antharas has been awakened, and asks you to join the party going to slay the dragon. She says that Antharas' Lair is surrounded by a magical field and is unapproachable, but she thinks that the portal stone may activate the heart of the field and allow...

title: Alligator Hunter
intro: Giant alligators threaten Innadril! Trader Enbern is looking for someone to help him capture some the beasts...
firstStep: Trader Enverun asks you to join him on a hunting excursion to Alligator Island. He offers to pay you a reward for each alligator pelt.

title: Subjugation of Lizardmen
intro: Whilst beset from all directions, yet another force has begun threatening Gludio! Lizardmen have begun looting and pillaging throughout the land! Destroy them and restore the peace!
firstStep: Guard Weisz's orders state that you must recover the cargo that belongs to the Aden trade union from the Felim lizardmen in the Fellmere Harvesting Grounds. Recover 30 units of cargo from the Felim lizardmen, Felim lizardman scouts and Felim lizardman warriors.

title: Hunting for Wild Beasts
intro: The salmon returned to the river as quick as lightning! Grocer Pano rushed to sell fishing supplies, but unforseen problems threaten his very existence...
firstStep: Grocer Pano asks you to drive away the bears that are threatening his proposed fishing resort west of Floran Village. Take 20 pelts to him to claim your reward. Hunt Dion grizzlies in the Dion Hills, grizzly bears and red bears on the Fellmere Harvesting Grounds, and brown bears on Windmill Hill.

title: Under the Shadow of the Ivory Tower
requirement: Human Wizard, Elven Wizard, Dark Wizard, SOrcerer/ss, Necromancer, Warlock, Spellsinger, Elemental Summoner, Spellhowler, Phantom Summoner
intro: The long-sought-after mineral, Nebulite, was used by the ancient giants as a magic amplifier. A secret mission is underway to secure a supply of it...
firstStep: Magic Trader Cema asks you to collect Nebulite orbs by killing monsters in a crater near the Ivory Tower of Oren. Dwarven Collector Marsha and Collector Trumpin were originally hired to do this work but Cema has not heard from them since they left. While collecting the orbs, if you happen to run into them, ask them what happened. Hunt manashen gargoyles...

title: 1000 years, the End of Lamentation
intro: Long ago, brave, sword-wielding warriors left to slay the land dragon, Antharas. Their shining armor and beautiful white horses gleaming in the sun, they headed off into the sunset to confront the beast, never to return...
firstStep: Antharas Watchman Gilmore seeks to avenge the soldiers who were made undead after failing in their brave attempt to subjugate the evil beast 1,000 years ago. He requests that you destroy the cave servants and recover the belongings of the fallen soldiers. Hunt cave servants, cave servant archers, cave servant warriors, cave servant captains and the royal...

title: Method to Raise the Dead
intro: After many hardships, Locksmith Dorothy and her friends succeeded in stealing the treasure of the legendary pirate, Zaken! The shining fang awaited them near the village.
firstStep: Locksmith Dorothy asks you to determine what happened to her recently vanished friends who disappeared along with a pirate's treasure. She fears that they were eaten by Crokians on the Field of Whispers and wants you to search there for their bones. Hunt Crokians and crokian warriors.

title: Go Get the Calculator.
intro: Isn't it said that insanity always lies at the heart of genius? Blacksmith Brunon dreams of being first to visit the moon, but must have something first...
firstStep: You must travel to the Dwarven Village to obtain a newly developed calculator for the blacksmith Brunon, who has promised a considerable reward. The Trade Guild will have information regarding the device.

title: An Arrogant Search
intro: Above the Tower of Insolence swirls a mysterious vortex. There the gods have sealed Baium, the arrogant creator of the tower. What can you learn there?
firstStep: A mysterious, swirling vortex over the tower of an ancient king.

title: Enhance Your Weapon
intro: A great, unknown darkness looms on the horizon... Sensing the coming chaos, the Magisters and Maestros are preparing secret ways to counter the threat.
firstStep: Many Magisters and Maestros have been recruiting volunteers to form a united front against the coming dark days. They have developed methods of strengthening weaponry as a way of empowering individual members of their forces. They tell you that now is the time to grow individual strength to prepare for the approaching darkness and ask you to learn to use...

title: Black Swan
intro: Tasaba lizardmen have stolen cargo belonging to Iason Heine, owner of the the most successful commercial guild in Heine! Kill the lizardmen and recover the cargo!
firstStep: Captain Gosta of Heine asks you to kill the Tasaba lizardmen that stole the cargo belonging to Iason Heine's Commercial Guild. Slay the Tasaba lizardmen and bring back their fangs or the barrels of league that were stolen and Iason Heine will give you a reward. Kill the Tasaba lizardmen and Tasaba lizardmen shamans.

title: Help Rood Raise A New Pet!
intro: Could it be true that a beautiful, noble pet has been discovered in the silent field of reeds?
firstStep: Pet Manager Rood of Heine wants to raise a new pet. He asks you to obtain lienrik eggs. A lienrik is a beautiful beast that lives in the Field of Silence. Female lienrik eggs are much rarer than male lienrik eggs. Hunt lienriks and lienrik lads.

title: Power of Darkness
intro: Galman spends his time alone in Dragon Valley... Nobody wants to go near him, but he has a story to tell...
firstStep: Galman is a businessman in Dragon Valley. He is very depressed because his lover is dying. Out of desperation he has begun delving into the powers of darkness. He asks you to find him a stone of contract. Hunt the Malruk succubus and the Malruk succubus turens.

title: Conquest of Alligator Island
intro: After being driven from their trade routes from Giran to Innadril by the Humans, the Dwarven guild authorities agreed to establish new markets for their goods. However, they may get more than they bargained for...
firstStep: Warehouse Freightman Kluck of Heine intends to develop a free trade zone on Alligator Island. He asks you to wipe out the evil creatures there and bring him their teeth as proof. Take 100 or more proofs to him at once and he will give you a bonus. Hunt crokian lads, dailaon lads, crokian lad warriors, farhite lads, nos lads and swamp tribes.

title: Family Honor
intro: Trader Galibredo claims to have royal blood in his veins. He claims to be a descendant of a distinguished aristocratic family of the ancient Elmoreden Empire. He seeks to regain the glory of the past and restore himself to his rightful place of honor…
firstStep: Although Trader Galibredo of the Town of Oren is now a mere merchant, his roots are aristocratic. Some time ago, he purchased several busts made by the ancient sculptor, Berona. As they were being delivered to him they were stolen by orcs. He desperately wishes to recover the ancient statues, regardless of the cost. He promises an extra reward each time you...

title: Dig Up the Sea of Spores!
intro: The Wizards of the Ivory Tower have sought to stem the spread of the Sea of Spores since ancient times. Now they want a permanent solution to this problem.
firstStep: Magister Gauen of the Ivory Tower wishes to perform an in-depth study of the Sea of Spores. He asks that you bring him 50 carnivore spores and 50 herbivorous spores. Perhaps he would settle for just 50 of one type... Hunt rotting trees and spore zombies.

title: Warehouse Keeper's Ambition
intro: Warehouse Chief Baxt recently announced retirement, and the competition to replace him has already grown fierce among the freightmen.
firstStep: Warehouse Freightman Silva wishes to become the next Warehouse Chief. She intends to obtain this position through the jade crystal business. She asks that you collect jade crystals for her. She offers an extra reward if you bring her 100 or more jade crystals at a time. You should hunt forest runners, Fline elders, Liele elders and valley treant elders.

title: Illegitimate Child of A Goddess
intro: Dark Elves think of Shilen as their mother, as she may well be, but children born of such lunacy are bound to cast a dark shadow...
firstStep: To protect Shilen's reputation, Grand Master Oltlin asks you to destroy the evil creatures that are evidence of her descent into madness. Collect 108 snake scales from the evil creatures that look like her and take them to Grand Master Oltlin. You will find them in front of the Forbidden Gateway. Hunt Falibati and Trives.

title: For Sleepless Deadmen
intro: The king's bitterness at his defeat was so great that it even transcended his death! To this day, he wanders his ruined castle...
firstStep: Knight Gustav of Elmore has resurrected the dead heroes of Aden to serve his evil purposes. Recover 60 of their remains and take them to High Priest Orven in Aden Castle so that they can be laid to rest. Hunt doom archers, doom guards and doom servants.

title: Plunder Their Supplies
intro: Kings, nobles and heroes are buried in the National Cemetery. Since the collapse of the kingdom, this holy place has been overrun with monsters! There are evil forces behind this.
firstStep: Monsters are defiling the Cemetery where the heroes of this kingdom are buried. You are part of the forces pledged to drive them out. You must interrupt their supply line, kill them and take all the supplies and documents they are carrying to Guard Coleman in Aden Castle Town. Hunt Taik orc seekers and Taik orc supply leaders.

title: Bard's Mandolin
intro: Music is the most beautiful form of expression!. A certain young man, shy and blinded by love, knows this all too well...
firstStep: Bard Swan, a secret admirer of Musician Nanarin, wants to give her a rare and precious flute. He asks that you visit Trader Woodrow, an importer of flutes.

title: Sorrowful Sound of Flute
intro: Music is the most beautiful form of expression! Even a certain lady of nobility with exquisite taste is helpless in its embrace!
firstStep: Dark Elf Nanarin, enchanted at the sight of Dwarf Barbado's bountiful beard, wishes to pursue a relationship with him but her pride keeps her from expressing her true feelings. She suggests you find out from the Dwarves in the village what he likes. Ask the Dwarves in the blacksmith shop and the warehouse.

title: Jovial Accordion
intro: Somebody said music is the most beautiful way to show yourself... The musician who loves music and calls himself the master of the melody, is looking for someone who can play with him...
firstStep: Barbado explains that he has long been an admirer of Swan's music and his fondest wish is to someday play a duet with him. Swan has not responded to his invitation, and Barbado has gotten the impression that Swan is avoiding him. Barbado asks you to visit Swan on his behalf.

title: Devil's Legacy
intro: Pirate Captain Zaken searched for treasure all his life. While he died an untimely death, his curse lives on, on Devil's Isle!
firstStep: Pirate Zaken's followers imprisoned him on Devil's Isle and stole his treasure, but he eventually got his revenge by killing them all and turning them into pirate zombies and pirate zombie captains. You must go there, conduct an investigation, recover the stolen treasure, and take it to Warehouse Keeper Randolf in Giran Castle Town.

title: Silver Haired Shaman
intro: Devil's Isle is home to the restless spirits of Pirate Captain Zaken and his men. That island holds some ghastly secrets...
firstStep: Magister Dieter of Giran Castle Town wishes to obtain the silver hair of Sairon which can be found on Devil's Isle. Rumor says that this hair is what gives the doll its power. Go to Devil's Isle and slay Sairon, her doll and puppet, and then take some of her silver hair to Magister Dieter.

title: Electrifying Recharge!
intro: All the best discoveries are accidental! What scientific secrets might we learn from the ancient giants?
firstStep: Researcher Lorain says that she has discovered the secret of the Titan's energy. She asks that you use an ancient item in a fight against Catherok, the monster of Cruma Tower and thereby expose the ancient item to the influence of the skill Catherok uses.

title: Trespassing into the Sacred Area
intro: The Garden of Eva is the holy sanctuary of the Goddess of Water! What are all those evil creatures doing there?!
firstStep: The Garden of Eva is the goddess' sanctuary. Lately, monsters have been invading it, and the garden guards are overwhelmed. Priestess Restina of Heine has requested the help of outsiders to drive out the monsters. Kill blade stakatos, blade stakato workers, blade stakato warriors, and blade stakato drones.

title: Collector of Jewels
intro: Magister Nell wants to know the connection between the soul stone found at the Elven Ruins on Talking Island and the one found at the Forgotten Temple... And that's not her only question!
firstStep: Magister Nell is researching the Forgotten Temple. After learning of a relationship between the Forgotten Temple and the Elven Ruins, she asks you to bring her back broken fragments of elemental stone. Obtain 50 flame shards and 50 ice shards. Hunt roxides, lakin undines, rowin undines, death fires, lakin salamanders and salamander rowins.

title: An Elder Sows Seeds
intro: The forbidden spellbook, used to protect against the devil Beleth, immediately transformed the once-fertile land south of Aden into a barren wasteland. Now, at last, Elder Casian has hopes of rekindling life there.
firstStep: Great Magus Kranvel's spellbook has been opened for the upcoming fight with Beleth. The magic power emanating from the book has destroyed fertile farmland and produced weird and grotesque creatures. Filled with rage and grief, Spellsinger Diena destroyed the magus's spellbook. Rumor says it is now located in the Ant Nest. Elder Casian wishes to open Great...

title: Shriek of Ghosts
intro: The Tower of Insolence was built with the blood and bones of its many innocent victims. That place is haunted by the souls of those wrongly executed there! Would you pacify them?
firstStep: Seer Reva of Aden Castle Town asks you to find an ancient ash urn. You can obtain it by going to the Tower of Insolence and killing the followers of the evil Hallate. You will receive an extra reward if you bring back 100 ash urns at once. If in your search you happen to find an ancient porcelain, take it to antique dealer Patrin in the Town of Oren and get...

title: Legacy of Insolence
intro: The Tower of Insolence is definitely one of the most marvelous structures in history! The Gray Pillar Guild, expert architects, felt they had to reclaim the inheritance of their Dwarven ancestors' technology.
firstStep: Warehouse Keeper Walderal belongs to the Gray Pillar Guild. He needs a blueprint of the Tower of Insolence to further his research. Slay the powerful enemies in the Tower of Insolence and recover the blueprint! If you find other books, ask Walderal about them. You must kill the corrupt sages, Erin Ediunce, Hallate's inspectors, platinum tribe overlords...

title: Supplier of Reagents
intro: The Ivory Tower is the crowning achievement of our civilization! Research done here will benefit future generations! Magic is the way of the future!
firstStep: You have agreed to obtain the reagent that Magic Trader Wesley needs for his magic research. Slay the evil creatures in the Tower of Insolence and the Blazing Swamp and collect reagent ingredients. Once you collect the ingredients, use the mixing urn in the basement of the Ivory Tower to create reagents. Refer to the note that is attached to the mixing urn...

title: Whisper of Dreams, Part 1
intro: A dark chaos is about to descend upon the world! Seer Manakia received a warning in a dream, and is planning a ceremony to try and better understand the coming darkness...
firstStep: Seer Manakia wants to perform a ritual to better predict the future. He asks you to obtain the items he needs. He needs 65 molars of cave beasts and 65 flames of death wave.

title: Whisper of Dreams, Part 2
intro: Seer Manakia is not able to adequately foresee the coming darkness. He asks for help in acquiring better materials.
firstStep: Seer Manakia asks you to obtain 100 skulls of cave howler and 100 horns of karik.

title: Exploration of the Giants' Cave, Part I
intro: Dwarf Sobling solved the puzzle of the past and revealed the truth. There's still something else he needs to do at Giants Cave.
firstStep: Head Researcher Sobling asks you to find the relics of ancient Titans that are guarded by monsters in the cave. Hunt yintzus, paliotes, hamruts and kranrots.

title: Exploration of Giants Cave, Part 2
requirement: Dictionary of Ancient Languages: Intermediate Level
intro: Sobling's efforts are finally starting to pay off. However, he says that there is still room for improvement.
firstStep: Head Researcher Sobling asks you to find the relics of the Titans from the deepest recesses of Giants Cave using the newly acquired "Ancient Language Dictionary: Intermediate Level". Hunt lesser giant soldiers, lesser giant scouts, lesser giant mages and lesser giant elders.

title: Magnificent Feast
requirement: Fantasy Wine, adept of Taste, Bring out the Flavor of Ingredients Quest has been fulfilled
intro: Chief Warehouse Keeper Lansfo has taken care of the warehouse at Dion for 40 years. Now he's been offered the promotion of a lifetime!
firstStep: Help Guard Harlan of the Town of Dion by obtaining and bringing back some top quality wine!

title: Fantasy Wine
intro: Fathers would brave the fires of hell for their daughters! Guard Harlan of Dion is no exception.
firstStep: It is the tradition of Guard Harlan's family in Dion Village to make wine whenever a new child is born. To celebrate the birth of a daughter, they plan to make fantasy wine. They need 80 leaves of eucalyptus and 100 stones of chill. Hunt Enku orc champions and Enku orc shamans.

title: Bring Out the Flavor of Ingredients!
intro: Dion is always packed for its monthly cooking contest. One magister who likes to cook plans to embarrass the other cooks with his expert technique!
firstStep: Magister Rollant of Dion Castle is an aspiring chef. He has become disillusioned by the shoddy practices of other chefs. Bring him four ritron fruits, 20 moon face flowers, 10 drops of leech fluids and two antidotes and he will make a top quality dish that is far superior to anything else. Hunt dire wolves, Kadif werewolves and giant mist leeches.

title: Let's Become a Royal Member!
requirement: Coin Collector Membership - 1, Completion of the Coins of Magic Quest
intro: The Coin Collectors Club has members from every land! Would you care to take the test to join?
firstStep: Warehouse Keeper Sorint explains that a royal membership program has recently been introduced for level 1 members. To become royalty you must obtain Kail's coin from the monsters of the Forsaken Plains. You must also obtain the coin collecting album sold by Trader Sandra in Giran. Hunt ancient gargoyles.

title: Kail's Magic Coin
intro: Kail, known as th right hand of the devil Beleth, had a habit of making weird coins. There is a certain collector who collects no others...
firstStep: Head Blacksmith Vergara has just joined the coin collecting club. He wants to trade his coins for rarer coins. Bring the coins Vergara wants so that he will give you the coins you want. Hunt fallen orcs, fallen orc archers, fallen orc shamans and fallen orc captains.

title: Searching for Treasure
intro: The legendary Pirate Captain Zaken left many legends and even more bodies in his wake! One story tells of his treasure, and it seems to be the one most people want to hear... Trader Espen can tell you more!
firstStep: Ask Trader Espen of Heine to decipher the pirate's treasure map for you.

title: Warehouse Keeper's Pastime
intro: Trading is mind-numbing work! Freightmen must make up their own ways to kill time.
firstStep: Some Warehouse Keeper's medals that were being delivered to the Town of Oren were stolen by monsters. Recover them and take them to Warehouse Freightman Cliff of the Town of Oren or Warehouse Chief Baxt of Hunters Village and you'll be allowed to play bingo. Monsters to Hunt - Tanor Canyon: nightmare lords, nightmare keepers and nightmare guides. Dragon...

title: Yoke of the Past
intro: The Gate Keeper Ziggurat, who longs to become Human again, asks you to slay the guardians and collect the scrolls of ancient magic.
firstStep: The Gatekeeper Ziggurat wants to become a human again and asks you to slay the guardians of ancient magic and collect the scrolls of ancient magic. You'll receive a blank scroll as a reward. The blank scroll will be helpful when dealing with the Trader of Mammon. Journey into the necropolises and catacombs and find monsters whose name contain lookout...

title: Stolen Dignity
intro: The Iron Gate Guild is furious that the infernium ore that it needs to construct a warehouse has been stolen by monsters! They have asked for assistance in recovering the ore.
firstStep: The infernium ore that the Iron Gate Guild needs to construct a warehouse has been stolen by monsters. Recover the infernium ore and take it to Warehouse Freightman Romp. For every 100 units of infernium ore you take to him, you can play one round of bingo. If you win, you'll receive a prize from the Iron Gate Guild. Monsters to Hunt - Ancient Battleground:...

title: Path to a Warrior
intro: All warriors must be courageous and tenacious. Do you possess these qualities?
firstStep: Quest that must be fulfilled in order to change occupations to a Warrior. Tell Master Aymus that you wish to become a Warrior, and he will tell you to first visit Trader Simplon in the Town of Gludio and find the 'Sword of Trial.'

title: Path to a Human Knight
intro: To become a Knight you must endure the legendary quest known as Path to a Human Knight.
firstStep: The quest to change one's occupation to Knight. Squires must travel to Gludin Village, the Town of Gludio, and Talking Island Village and run errands for captains and high priests. Gather three or more Coins of Lords.

title: Path to a Rogue
intro: Speak first with Guard Bezique if you wish to follow the Path to a Rogue.
firstStep: Quest to change occupation to Rogue. Find Captain Bezique and tell him you wish to become a Rogue. He says that in order to earn his respect, you must catch one of the thieves. He suggests you meet with Neti.

title: Path to a Human Wizard
intro: Wizards must have a deep understanding of the power and meanings of each of the four elements. A token of fire is essential if you are to follow the Path to a Wizard!
firstStep: The quest to change occupation to Wizard. Parina asks that you find tokens which symbolize earth, fire, water, and wind. Go to the Ruins of Despair and meet the fire spirit salamander.

title: Path to a Cleric
intro: Potential Clerics should confiscate subversive books and take them to Priest Zigaunt... He'll be very impressed!
firstStep: Quest that must be fulfilled to change occupation to Cleric. Tell Priest Zigaunt that you wish to become a Cleric, and he ask you to prove your pure faith. To do this, you must remove all inappropriate books that criticize the current order. The first rumors about those books appeared in the Town of Gludio. Go there and ask Trader Simplon about the book...

title: Path to an Elven Knight
intro: For millenia Elven warriors have traveled either the path of the sword or the path of the arrow. Both paths inevitably lead through Eva and Einhasad...
firstStep: Quest that must be fulfilled in order to change occupation to Elven Knight. Tell Master Sorius that you wish to become an Elven Knight. He will order you to go to the Ruins of Agony and defeat the undead to collect pieces of topaz. The undead will include tracker skeletons, tracker skeleton leaders, skeleton scouts, skeleton bowmen, and raging spartoi.

title: Path to an Elven Scout
intro: Elven Scouts are the most dextrous and elegant of all Elves! To become Scouts they must first prove their worth in battle...
firstStep: The quest that must be fulfilled to change one's occupation to that of an Elven Scout. In order to become an Elven Scout, Master Reisa tells you to prove your skills by finding Guard Moretti's lost friend.

title: Path to an Elven Wizard
intro: Elven Wizards have a way with spirits... But first, they must perform a ritual for Eva...
firstStep: Quest that must be fulfilled to change occupation to Elven Wizard. Rosella tells you that to become an Elven Wizard, you must collect the jewels that represent each of the four elements: water, fire, wind and earth. She hands you the fertility period, which symbolizes earth, and asks you to find the rest.

title: Path to an Elven Oracle
intro: The revelation of flame has been passed down among Elven priests for centuries. Rumors persist that a girl of revelation has appeared recently...
firstStep: This quest must be fulfilled to change occupation to Oracle. Tell Priest Manuel that you wish to become an Oracle. He tells you about the Revelation of the TOrch, and asks you to investigate the truth about the recent appearance of a miraculous girl near the lighthouse in Gludin Harbor.

title: Path to a Palus Knight
intro: Dark Elven Knights must pass two trials to become an elite Palus Knight. Are you worthy to join them?
firstStep: Quest that must be fulfilled to change occupation to Palus Knight. Master Virgil asks that you capture the 'gaze of abyss' through a trial in order to become a Palus Knight. He says you must then go to the Neutral Zone and bring back 13 Lycanthrope Skulls needed for the 13 Skull Ceremony. This will fulfill the first stage of the trial.

title: Path to an Assassin
intro: A Warrior of Darkness is a ruthless, silent assassin. Find Arkenia at the altar of coming-of-age ceremony and prove yourself to her.
firstStep: Quest that must be fulfilled to change occupation to Assassin. To become an Assassin, Triskell asks you to prove your skills by helping Witch Arkenia who can be found at the Altar of Rites.

title: Path to a Dark Wizard
intro: Shilen is the mother of the dark arts. To become a Dark Wizard, one must prove capable of controlling the spirits with her power.
firstStep: Quest that must be fulfilled to change occupation to Dark Wizard. Witch Varika speaks of the four seeds representing anger, despair, horror, and lunacy. One who obtains them all may become a Dark Wizard. She gives you a Seed of Despair and asks you to find the rest.

title: Path to a Shillien Oracle
intro: Shillien Oracles seek truth and enlightenment in the darkness that surrounds us. Not all are worthy of such a noble profession.
firstStep: Quest that must be fulfilled to change occupation to Shillien Oracle. Magister Sidra explains that to become a Shilien Oracle you must acquire two books written in ancient rune: the 'Garmiel book' and the 'Andariel book'. First you must visit Magister Talbot in the Village of Gludin, and learn how to obtain the Garmiel book.

title: Path to an Orc Raider
intro: Orc Raiders inspire fear in their enemies with their death-defying courage and royal bearing.
firstStep: Quest that must be fulfilled to change occupation to Orc Raider. Prefect Karukia says that Orc Raiders must prove that their courage and loyalty are without fault. To prove your courage you must destroy the Goblins and their Kuruka Ratmen helpers that are ruining this land. Kill Goblin Tomb Raider Leaders and Kuruka Ratman Leaders.

title: Path to a Monk
intro: Orc Monks are masters of the traditional Orc martial art, kabart. The path of Monk requires that they receive scrolls from two masters.
firstStep: You must undertake this quest in order to change your occupation to Monk. Gantaki Zu Urutu will instruct you in traditional Orc martial arts. He informs you that you must receive a scroll from two Masters. Go first to Khavatari Rosheek, who is training somewhere on the Immortal Plateau.

title: Path to an Orc Shaman
intro: Orc Shamans must master the language of fire in order to communicate with souls on the battlefield.
firstStep: Quest that must be fulfilled to change occupation to Orc Shaman. Tataru Zu Hestui explains that in order to become an Orc Shaman, you must learn to lead spirits. In order to accomplish this, you must master the 'Language of Fire' which will enable you to communicate with spirits. There are three items needed to prepare for learning the language of fire. You...

title: Path to become a Scavenger
intro: Master Toma, teacher of the way of scavenger, is missing! You must find him!
firstStep: This quest must be fulfilled before transferring to Scavenger class. Collector Pippi of the Dwarven Village encourages all aspiring Dwarves to become Scavengers. To become a Scavenger, you must receive the permission of Master Toma, whose whereabouts are currently unknown. It is said that his younger sister, Trader Mion of Dwarven Village, may know his...

title: Path to an Artisan
intro: Dwarven Artisans are consummate craftsmen. They must pass tests from three blacksmiths.
firstStep: Quest that must be fulfilled to change occupation to Artisan. The Dwarf Village Blacksmith Silvery tells you that to become an Artisan you must receive recognition from three Blacksmiths that have been Artisans for a long time. He asks you to go to the Abandoned Coal Mines and obtain 10 boogle ratman teeth and two boogle ratman leader's big teeth.

title: Get a Pet
intro: A pet will be your friend in the most difficult of times. It's not easy to acquire one, however.
firstStep: To receive a pet, you must earn the approval of Pet Manager Martin in Gludin Village. He says that you must have love for and knowledge of animals to prove that you deserve a pet. He asks you to return to your hometown, eliminate all animal killers and return to him.

title: Little Wing
intro: Hatchlings are, quite honestly, ugly little creatures! But how else are you to get a strider and wyvern?
firstStep: Quest that must be completed in order to obtain a pet hatchling. Visit Pet Manager Cooper and tell him that you wish to raise a hatchling. He will tell you to seek help from Elder Cronos of Hunters Village.

title: Little Wing's Big Adventure
requirement: At least Hatchling Level 55, One Dragonflute
intro: Raising a fat, lazy hatchling isn't an easy task! You shall now reap the harvest of your hard work!
firstStep: Elder Cronos suggests you consult Fairy Mimyu concerning the raising of Hatchling to Strider.

title: Repent Your Sins
intro: The Black Judge gives sinners a chance for redemption. Will you follow the path of penitence, sinner? Be warned, it is sure to be filled with trials and tribulations!
firstStep: The Black Judge tells the sinner that he has a chance for redemption. Will you follow the path of penitence, sure to be filled with trials and tribulations?

title: Quest for Fishing Shot
intro: Members of the Fishermen's Guild in each village are known for making fishing shots from a sweet fluid that the water spirits like.
firstStep: In order to create a fishing shot, you must collect sweet fluid that the water spirits are fond of. Any member of the Fishermen's Guild can tell you where to find it.

title: Wedding March
intro: Melody Maestro Kantabilon has found the musical score for a wedding march and asks you to get a special echo crystal to contain the song.
firstStep: Melody Maestro Kantabilon asks that you bring him some Silver Crystals for him to store his new song in. Hunt Lienriks in the Field of Silence and collect 50 Silver Crystals. Monsters to Hunt -Lienriks, Lienrik Lads

title: Birthday Party Song
intro: The beautiful weather has inspired Melody Maestro Octavia to finish a musical birthday piece. Will you help her to store it?
firstStep: Melody Maestro Octavia asks you to bring her some Red Crystals to hold a new song. Hunt Roughly-Hewn Rock Golems in the Floran Agricultural Area and bring back 50 Red Crystals. Monster to Hunt - Roughly-Hewn Rock Golems

title: Proof of Clan Alliance
intro: The winds of destiny have brought you to this place! The chaotic chronicle must cease! When we accomplish this, our clan will be stronger than ever! Arise!
firstStep: Quest that must be completed in order to raise a clan level to level 4. Sir Kristof Rodemai of the Town of Giran is seeking a clan leader to restore order in the kingdom. Find Sir Rodemai and speak to him. He will say that he cannot join forces with someone whose skills are yet unproven, and recommends you to first attempt and pass the trial of Witch Kalis...

title: Pursuit of Clan Ambition!
intro: Sir Gustav Athebaldt has grave concerns about the future of the kingdom. He wants nothing more than to help the young and courageous leaders to bring peace to the land! If you join forces with him in the Town of Oren, he'll give you a proof of expectation, increasing the power of the clan!
firstStep: Quest that must be fulfilled in order to raise a clan to level 5. Upon meeting Sir Gustav Athebaldt in the Town of Oren, he expresses his desire to aid the young and courageous leaders of the kingdom. He promises to give you the 'Seal of Aspiration,' which is needed when expanding the clan's powers and influences should you agree to join forces with him...

title: Competition for the Bandit Stronghold
requirement: Clan Leader, Over Clan Level 4, 1hour before the Clan Hall War
intro: A holy war has broken out over the position of ol mahum chief of the Bandit Stronghold! The competition has become so fierce that it's been opened up to outsiders!
firstStep: This quest must be accomplished in order to participate in a clan hall war. You must be the first of five to kill Tarlk bugbears and Tarlk basilisks and bring back 30 proofs. Successful completion of this quest permits participation in a clan hall war. In the Forest of Evil, hunt Tarlk Bugbears, Tarlk Bugbear Warriors and Tarlk Bugbear High Warriors. In the...

title: Blood Offering
requirement: Level appropriate group. Only available during SSQ Competition Period.
intro: Kill as many evil creatures as possible within 18 minutes!
firstStep: Slay as many of evil creatures as you can within 18 minutes and collect the blood offering! If you wish to quit without completing the festival, or if you wish to make the festival more challenging, speak with a Festival Witch.

title: A Clan's Reputation
requirement: Clan Leader, Clan Level 5 and above
intro: Sir Eric Rodemai in Aden Castle Town is looking for a brave adventurer to raise the clan's reputation.
firstStep: Sir Eric Rodemai of Aden Castle Town needs a brave adventurer to help boost the clan's reputation by defeating the Raid Bosses currently terrorizing the townspeople. Get more details from Sir Eric.

title: The Clan's Prestige
requirement: Clan Leader, Clan Level 6 and above
intro: Grand Magister Baldis in the Rune Township is looking for a powerful clan that can enhance the clan's prestige.
firstStep: Grand Magister Valdis of the Rune Township is looking for a brave mage to help enhance the clan's prestige by defeating the Raid Bosses currently terrorizing the townspeople. Get more details from Grand Magister Valdis.

title: A Clan's Reputation
requirement: Clan Leader, Clan Level 5 and above
intro: Grand Magister Valdis of Rune Township needs a special ingredient in order to craft weapons and armor for his guards.
firstStep: Grand Magister Valdis in Rune Township is looking for a clan anxious to enhance its reputation. If you retrieve the Tyrannosaurus claw that he needs from the Primeval Isle, he promises to help you increase your clan's reputation. Go find the Tyrannosaurus claw.

title: Watching Eyes
intro: The Eye of Argos asks you to kill the disciples that are making its life miserable.
firstStep: The Eye of Argos orders you to punish the disciples who tormented him and bring back 100 marks of disciple. Monsters to Hunt - Disciples of Protection, Disciples of Punishment, Disciples of Authority

title: Shadow of Light
intro: When Daimon the White-Eyed tries to control the monsters here, the Eye of Argos sought soldiers to defeat him.
firstStep: The Eye of Argos orders you to catch monsters controlled by the family of Daimon the White-Eyed and collect 100 eyes of darkness in order to prevent Daimon from expanding his power. Monsters to Hunt - Buffalo Slaves, Grendel Slaves

title: Daimon the White-Eyed - Part 1
intro: The Eye of Argos asks you to destroy the gigantic eye born of his dark side.
firstStep: The Eye of Argos orders you to find the ancient tablet that describes how the ancient heroes defeated Daimon the White-Eyed.

title: Daimon the White-Eyed - Part 2
requirement: Completion of "Daimon the White-Eyed - Part 1" quest. Unfinished Bead of Summoning
intro: The Eye of Argos gives you a bead of summoning and asks you to destroy Daimon the White-Eyed.
firstStep: The Eye of Argos gives you a bead of summoning to call Daimon the White-Eyed and tells you to go to the Altar of Daimon, summon Daimon and kill him.

title: Alliance with Ketra Orcs
intro: Messenger Wahkan asks you to be an ally of Ketra Orcs and join them in fighting Varka Silenos, the sworn enemy of Ketra Orcs...
firstStep: To obtain a "Mark of Ketra's Alliance - Level 1" as proof of your acceptance by the Ketra Orcs, you must bring back 100 "Varka's Badges - Soldier". Monsters to Hunt - Varka Silenos Recruits, Varka Silenos Footmen, Varka Silenos Scouts, Varka Silenos Hunters and Varka Silenos Shamans.

title: War with Varka Silenos
requirement: Mark of Ketra's Alliance - Level 1 or higher.
intro: Kadun Zu Ketra, the chief of Ketra Orcs is looking for a brave fighter who will defeat Varka Silenos, their sworn enemy...
firstStep: Hierarch Kadun Zu Ketra has issued the order to attack! Go to their stronghold and slay the Varka Silenos! As proof, collect and bring back 100 manes of Varka Silenos. If you harm a Ketra Orc while carrying out this mission, your mark of ally will be downgraded one level and the alliance will be broken. Monsters to Hunt - Varka Silenos Recruits, Varka...

title: Prove your courage!
intro: You heard the news that Kadun Zu Hestui, the elder of Ketra Orcs is looking for a warrior who can defeat Shadith, the hero of the Varka Silenos tribe.
firstStep: Kadun Zu Ketra, the elder of Ketra Orcs has assigned to you the Test of Courage. Go to Varka Silenos Stronghold, slay Varka's Hero Shadith and bring back his head. While carrying out the mission, if you attack a Ketra Orc, the mission will be canceled automatically. Monster to hunt - Varka's Hero Shadith

title: Slay the enemy commander!
intro: You heard the news that Kadun Zu Hestui, the elder of Ketra Orcs is looking for a warrior who can defeat Shadith, the hero of the Varka Silenos tribe.
firstStep: Kadun Zu Ketra, the elder of Ketra Orcs has issued a special strategic order. Go to the Varka Silenos Stronghold, slay Varka's commander Mos and bring back his head. While carrying out the mission, if you attack a Ketra Orc, this mission will be canceled automatically. Monster to hunt - Varka's commander Mos

title: Magical Power of Water - Part 1
requirement: Ketra Orc's Alliance - Level 2 or Higher
intro: Ketra's Messenger Wahkan has given you the assignment to steal the source of the magical power from the shaman of Varka Silenos, their enemy...
firstStep: Meet Asefa in the Ketra Orc Village. However, if you ever harm a Ketra Orc while carrying out this mission, your mark of ally will be downgraded one level and the alliance will be broken.

title: Magical Power of Water - Part 2
requirement: Mark of Ketra's Alliance - Level 2 or Higher. In addition, only a character who has fulfilled the "Magical Power of Water - Part 1" quest can pursue this quest.
intro: You must use the totem you stole from the shaman of Varka Silenos to summon the Spirit of Water and slay it...
firstStep: Go to the sacred altar of Varka Silenos and use the green totem. A spirit of water will appear. Kill it and obtain the essence of its power! However, if you ever harm a Ketra Orc while carrying out this mission your mark of ally will be downgraded one level and the alliance will be broken. Monster to Hunt - Ashutar, the Spirit of Water

title: Alliance with Varka Silenos
intro: Naran Ashanuk, Varka's Messenger asks you to become a friend of Varka Silenos and join them in fighting against Ketra Orcs their sworn enemy...
firstStep: In order to obtain the Mark of Varka's Alliance - Level 1, you must first bring back 100 Ketra's Badges - Soldier. Monsters to Hunt - Ketra Orc Footmen, Ketra Orc Raiders, Ketra Orc Scouts, Ketra Orc Shamans and Ketra's War Hounds.

title: War with Ketra Orcs
requirement: Mark of Varka's Alliance - Level 1 or higher.
intro: Ashas Varka Durai, Varka Silenos' Chief is looking for a fighter who will defeat Ketra Orcs, the sworn enemy of Varka Silenos...
firstStep: Elder Ashas Varka Durai issued the order to attack! Go to the Ketra Orc Outpost and slay the enemy, Ketra Orcs. And as proof, collect and bring back 100 molars of Ketra Orcs. However, if you ever harm a Varka Silenos while carrying out this mission, the mission will be cancelled automatically. Monsters to hunt - Ketra Orc Footman, Ketra Orc Raider, Ketra...

title: Prove your courage!
intro: Ashas Varka Durai, Varka Silenos' Chief is looking for a fighter who will defeat Ketra Orcs, the sworn enemy of Varka Silenos...
firstStep: Ashas Varka Durai, the elder of Varka Silenos has assigned to you the Test of Courage. Go to the Ketra Orc Outpost, slay Ketra's Hero Hekaton and bring back his head. Monster to hunt - Ketra's Hero Hekaton. While carrying out the mission, if you attack a Varka Silenos, this mission will be cancelled automatically.

title: Slay the enemy commander!
intro: Ashas Varka Durai, Varka Silenos' Chief is looking for a fighter who will defeat Ketra Orcs, the sworn enemy of Varka Silenos...
firstStep: Ashas Varka Durai, the elder of Varka Silenos has issued a special strategic order. Go to Ketra Orc Outpost, slay Ketra's commander Tayr and bring back his head. Monster to hunt - Ketra Commander Tayr While carrying out the mission, if you attack a Varka Silenos, this mission will be cancelled automatically.

title: Magical Power of Fire - Part 1
requirement: Varka Silenos' Alliance - Level 2 or Higher
intro: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk has given you the assignment to steal the source of the magical power from the shaman of Ketra Orcs, their enemy...
firstStep: Meet Udan Mardui, Guide of Dead Souls, who is located in the Varka Silenos Village. However, if you ever harm a Varka Silenos while carrying out this mission, the mission will be cancelled automatically.

title: Magical Power of Fire - Part 2
requirement: Mark of Varka's Alliance - Level 2 or Higher. In addition, only a character who has fulfilled the "Magical Power of Fire - Part 1" quest can pursue this quest.
intro: You must use the totem you stole from the shaman of Ketra Orcs to summon the Spirit of Water and slay it...
firstStep: Go to the sacred altar of Ketra Orcs and use the red totem. Then, a spirit of fire will appear. Kill the spirit of fire and obtain the essence of its power! However, if you ever harm a Varka Silenos while carrying out this mission, the mission will be cancelled automatically. Monster to hunt - Nastron, the Spirit of Fire.

title: Gather the Flames
intro: Vulcan is collecting flames in the lower level of the Forge of the Gods. He'll give you a special reward if you defeat all the monsters there and bring him the flames that you collect.
firstStep: Blacksmith Vulcan is collecting the Torches located in the lower level of the Forge of the Gods. You can obtain them by slaying the monsters within the Forge of the Gods. Take 1,000 Torches to Vulcan and he will give you a random S-grade weapon recipe. Blacksmith Rooney, who is wandering in the Forge of the Gods, is also collecting the Torches. Take 1,200...

title: Into the Flame
intro: You'll need a set of floating stones to enter the Flame Pass within the Forge of the Gods.
firstStep: Klein says you must have a set of floating stones to enter the Flame Pass. You can create the set of floating stones with vacualite. Speak with Blacksmith Hilda in the Town of Goddard to obtain vacualite.

title: Relics of the Old Empire
intro: The Ghost of Adventurer collects relics of the nobles who were killed when they came to the cemetery to pay their respects. Take him 1000 relics and he'll give you a reward.
firstStep: The Ghost of Adventurer collects relics of the nobles who were killed when they came to the cemetery to pay their respects. Take him 1000 relics and he'll give you a reward. Monsters to Hunt - All the Monsters inside of the Imperial Tomb

title: Four Goblets
intro: The Nameless Spirit at the entrance of the Four Sepulchers is collecting 4 goblets which you can get from the Shadows of Halisha inside the Four Sepulchers.
firstStep: The Nameless Spirit at the entrance to the four Sepulchers is collecting four goblets that can be recovered by killing the Shadows of Halisha. Kill the Shadows of Halisha deep inside of the four Sepulchers and collect the four goblets. Monsters to Hunt - Shadows of Halisha

title: Egg Delivery
intro: Chef Jeremy is looking for someone to deliver boiled eggs to his customers.
firstStep: You've decided to become Jeremy's eggman. Deliver the boiled eggs to Pulin in the northeast part of the Hot Springs area.

title: Specialty Liquor Delivery
intro: Chef Jeremy is looking for someone to deliver special liquor to his customers.
firstStep: You've decided to become Jeremy's liquor delivery person. Deliver the special liquor to Beolin in the north of the Hot Springs area.

title: The Finest Food
intro: Chef Jeremy asks you to gather the ingredients so he can develop a special regional dish.
firstStep: Chef Jeremy asks you to obtain 100 Flava Leaves, 100 Pieces of Buffalo Meat and 100 Antelope Horns in order to make a dish that will definitely impress the nobles who insulted him. Monsters to Hunt - Hot Springs Flava, Hot Springs Buffalo, Hot Springs Antelope

title: The Finest Ingredients - Part 1
intro: Chef Jeremy asks you to gather ingredients to attract Icicle Emperor Bumbalump, the king of yetis, so you can get some excellent yeti meat.
firstStep: Chef Jeremy needs some yeti meat to win the cooking contest. He asks you to bring him some. Monsters to Hunt - Hot Springs Atrox, Hot Springs Atroxspawn, Hot Springs Bandersnatchlings, Hot Springs Nepenthes

title: The Finest Ingredients - Part 2
requirement: Completion of the "The Finest Ingredients - Part 1" quest.
intro: Chef Jeremy asks you to gather ingredients to attract Icicle Emperor Bumbalump, the king of yetis, so you can get some excellent yeti meat.
firstStep: Chef Jeremy cooked a very special dish for the Icicle Emperor Bumbalump. Go to the yeti's table, put the dish down and wait for him.

title: A Dark Twilight
intro: The Hierarch in charge of the Evil Altar asks you to eliminate those who interfere with the activities of his followers.
firstStep: The Hierarch asks you to eliminate the splendors and collect Blood of Saint as proof. Get rid of them and obtain 300 units of Blood of Saint. Monsters to Hunt - Eye of Splendor, Flash of Splendor, Blade of Splendor, Wisdom of Splendor, Soul of Splendor, Victory of Splendor, Punishment of Splendor, Shout of Splendor, Signet of Splendor, Crown of Splendor and...

title: Heart in Search of Power
intro: The Mysterious Necromancer stands morosely near the entrance of the Valley of Saints. He says that he's gathering materials for his research into increased power.
firstStep: The Mysterious Necromancer asks you to collect 300 Beads of Obedience. Monsters to Hunt - Eye of Splendor, Flash of Splendor, Blade of Splendor, Wisdom of Splendor, Soul of Splendor, Victory of Splendor, Punishment of Splendor, Shout of Splendor, Signet of Splendor, Crown of Splendor and Wailing of Splendor

title: Hunt of the Golden Ram Mercenary Force
intro: The Golden Ram Mercenary Force is currently recruiting! This prestigious mercenary force is currently carrying out the mission of subjugating/driving out stakatos from the Swamp of Screams...
firstStep: In order to join the Golden Ram Mercenary Force, you must first prove your ability. Go to the Swamp of Screams, slay stakatos and collect the proofs. After completing the mission, return to Mercenary Kahman. Monsters to Hunt - Splinter Stakatos, Splinter Stakato Workers, Splinter Stakato Soldiers and Splinter Stakato Drones

title: Clean up the Swamp of Screams
requirement: Golden Ram Badge - Recruit or Golden Ram Badge - Soldier
intro: Pierce, captain of the Golden Ram Mercenary Force has assigned the task of driving out stakatos to you. You must go to the Swamp of Screams to carry out this mission...
firstStep: Pierce, captain of the Golden Ram Mercenary Force has assigned you the task of driving out the stakatos. Go to the Swamp of Screams and slay splinter stakatos and needle stakatos. As proof of your success, collect 100 claws of stakatos. When you bring them back to the barracks of the mercenary force, you'll receive a reward. Monsters to Hunt - Splinter...

title: Delicious Top Choice Meat
intro: The best meat comes from a mature animal, but with no one left to raise them, those animals have become too fierce to approach!
firstStep: Tunatun needs good quality meat. You get the best if you butcher a beast in the Pasturelands when it's grown large enough. Hunt beasts for food and fame! Monsters to Hunt - Alpen Kookaburras, Alpen Buffalos and third-stage Alpen Cougars

title: Necromancer's Request
intro: The Necromancer in the Forest of the Dead asks you to destroy the vampires that are interfering with his collection of magic materials.
firstStep: The Mysterious Wizard in the Forest of the Dead town asks two things. Kill vampires and hunt the undead that show up at night. Do this for him. Monsters to Hunt - Vampire - Devil Bats, Atrox and all other vampires in the Forest of the Dead. General Undead: Corrupted Knights, Resurrected Knights, Corrupted Royal Guards, Resurrected Royal Guards, Slaughter...

title: In the Forgotten Village
intro: The Forgotten Village inside the Forest of the Dead. The people here are constantly harassed by undead and Dark Mages. Help them!
firstStep: Mina asks you to do two things for her. Kill Dark Mages and hunt the undead. Do her this favor. Monster to Hunt - Magus of Dark Arts: Bone Snatcher, Bone Maker, Bone Collector, Bone Animator, Bone Slayer, Bone Sweeper, Bone Grinder, Bone Caster, Bone Puppeteer, Bone Scavenger, Bone Shaper, Skull Collector, Skull Animator, Undead Monster: Trampled Men...

title: In Search of Fragments of Dimension
intro: You need a Dimensional Fragment in order to temporarily stay within the Dimensional Rift. Get as many Dimensional Fragments as possible.
firstStep: You must obtain a Dimensional Fragment if you intend to fight within the Dimensional Rift. Monsters to Hunt - Necropolis, Catacombs: monsters whose name contains Lookout, Watcher, Guard, Monk, Overlord, Shaman, Consul, Inquisitor, Guardian, Elder, Court Guard and Preacher, excluding Nephilim, Lilim, Gigant and Lilith.

title: In the Dimensional Rift
intro: Destroy all of the monsters within the Dimensional Rift. The number of teleports are limited, so you must work quickly!
firstStep: Defeat the devils within the Dimensional Rift.

title: Truth Beyond the Gate
intro: The Priest Eliyah in the Rune Township knows how to get into the Temple of the Pagans.
firstStep: The Temple of the Pagans is heavily guarded. You may be able to sneak in by disguising yourself as a live sacrifice for the Temple… Go to Flauron and pretend to be lured into his trap.

title: Through the Gate Once More
intro: The Priest Flauron seems like he has something to ask the person who bears the Faded Visitor's Mark.
firstStep: The Priest Flauron tells you to bring back 10 Necromancer Hearts from the Forest of the Dead. Monsters to Hunt: Bone Animators, Bone Slayers, Skull Animators

title: Seekers of the Holy Grail
intro: High Priest Innocentin of the Rune Township is trying to prevent the pagans from capturing the Grail of Splendor.
firstStep: High Priest Innocentin is trying to prevent the pagans from capturing the Grail of Splendor. Innocentin will reward you if you defeat the monsters in the Temple of the Pagans and collect more than 2000 pagan totems. Monsters to Hunt: All the monsters in the Temple of the Pagans

title: Guardians of the Holy Grail
intro: Priest Dominic of the Rune Township is trying to obtain something hidden in the Monastery of Silence.
firstStep: Priest Dominic is trying to obtain something hidden in the Monastery of Silence. He will reward you if you can bring the Monk Scriptures to him. In addition, he asks you to help Gremory if you meet him in the Monestary. Monsters to Hunt: All the monsters in the Monestary of Silence

title: The Zero Hour
requirement: Completion of the In Search of the Nest Quest
intro: The Mercenary Captain Pierce located the Stakato Nest and commited all his troops there in order to finish the arduous battle.
firstStep: The Mercenary Kahman asks you to kill Stakatos in the nest and bring back their fangs as proof. Monsters to Hunt: Spiked Stakatos, Spiked Stakato Workers, Spiked Stakato Guards, Male Spiked Stakatos, Female Spiked Stakatos, Spiked Stakato Sorcerers, Canibalistic Stakato Leader, Spiked Stakato Soldiers, Spiked Stakato Drones, Spiked Stakato Captain, Spiked...

title: Attack Sailren!
requirement: Completion of "The Name of Evil - 2" Quest
intro: At the Elroki chief's camp on Primeval Isle, Asamah asks you to help save the Elroki tribe from an impending danger. To do so, you must defeat Sailren, a fearsome dinosaur of incredible power.
firstStep: Shilen's Stone Statue tells you that you can obtain Gazkh Fragments by hunting the predatory Velociraptor and Pterosaur dinosaurs. You must obtain 30 Gazkh Fragments and bring them back to Shilen's Stone Statue. Monsters to Hunt: Velociraptor, Pterosaur.

title: A Powerful Primeval Creature
intro: The discovery of powerful primitive creatures on the Primeval Isle has sparked interest from the magicians, who are curious about the creatures' origin, and from the blacksmiths, who are interested in what items can be crafted from the creatures. Both groups are eager to find adventurers willing to brave the dangers of Primeval Isle to bring back the...
firstStep: The discovery of powerful primitive creatures on the Primeval Isle has sparked the interest of magicians curious about the creatures' origin and blacksmiths eager to learn what items can be crafted from the creatures' hides, bones and claws. Dinn asks that you scavenge the carcasses of Dinosaurs you kill for any useful remains. He also offers a reward to...

title: Rise and Fall of the Elroki Tribe
intro: Powerful primitive creatures called dinosaurs abound on Primeval Isle. The magicians want dinosaur bones for their research, while the native Elrokians need dinosaur bones to help restore the tribe to its former glory. Both groups need an adventurer willing to defeat the dinosaurs and return with the needed bones.
firstStep: The Magician Karakawei, who is researching ancient creatures, needs dinosaur bones as research ingredients. The Primeval Isle's native shaman also needs dinosaur bones for some ritual. Monsters to Hunt: Pachycephalosaurus, Wild Striders

title: Grave Robber Annihilation
intro: Karuda says that the vengeful spirits are increasing because of the grave robbers' activities and asks you to eliminate the grave robbers.
firstStep: The number of vengeful spirits among the graves of the tribe of the betrayers is growing because of increased grave robber activity. Defeat the grave robbers and take back 120 stolen grave items. Monsters to Hunt: Grave Robber Scouts, Grave Robber Lookouts, Grave Robber Rangers, Grave Robber Guards,Grave Robber Fighters

title: Ghosts of Batur
intro: The vengeful spirits are increasing because of the grave robbers' activities, and Karuda needs help preventing something evil from happening.
firstStep: Karuda says that the number of vengeful spirits is increasing so quickly that they may soon be able to enter the Immortal Plateau. He asks you to help them depart from this world in peace. Monsters to Hunt: Ghost of a Soldier, Ghost of a Loyal Vassal, Ghost of a General, Ghost of a Batur Chief, Ghost of a Morek Chief, Ghost of a Turka Chief

title: Signs of Revolt
intro: Torrant says that the Ragna Orcs are preparing to revolt and asks you to undermine their fighting power before the troops arrive.
firstStep: The Beacon Tower Manager Torrant asks you to snatch 180 Cursed Dolls--the medium that controls the evil creatures--to weaken the fighting power of the Ragna Orcs, who are planning a revolt. Monsters to Hunt: Ragna Orcs, Ragna Orc Shaman, Ragna Orc Archer, Ragna Orc Warrior, Ragna Orc Mage, Ragna Orc Healer, Ragna Orc Hero, Ragna Orc Commander, Ragna Orc...

title: Influx of Machines
intro: The Collector Gutenhagen wants to clear the Pavel Ruins of Golems in order to research them.
firstStep: Collector Gutenhagen has asked you to hunt Golems at the Pavel Ruins. Monsters to Hunt: Probe Golem Prodigy IV, Menacing Jackhammer Golem, Horrifying Cannon Golem I, Horrifying Cannon Golem IV, Cruel Vice Golem, Probe Golem Champion I, Horrifying Excavator Golem III, Bloodthirsty Ginzu Golem VII, Bloodthirsty Ginzu Golem II, Ginzu Golem Prodigy X...

title: An Ice Merchant's Dream
intro: Rafforty is collecting crystals of ice for his guild.
firstStep: Rafforty asks you to find a Silver Ice Crystal. They are guarded by creatures in the Frozen Labyrinth. Monsters to Hunt: Massive Maze Bandersnatch, Lost Watcher, Elder Lost Watcher, Panthera, Lost Gargoyle, Lost Gargoyle Youngling, Pronghorn, Pronghorn Spirit, Ice Tarantula, Frost Tarantula, Frost Iron Golem, Frost Buffalo, Lost Baffalo, Ursus, Lost Yeti...

title: A Looter and a Railroad Man
intro: Railroad Worker Obi in the Plunderous Plains is plagued by incessant bandit attacks. Help him!
firstStep: Railroad Worker Obi asked you to defeat the Rayito bandits and bring back 200 stolen items. Monsters to Hunt: Bandit Sweeper, Bandit Hound, Bandit Watchman, Bandit Undertaker, Bandit Assassin, Bandit Warrior, Bandit Inspector, Bandit Captain

title: A Broken Dream
requirement: Completion of the "Ocean of Distant Stars" quest
intro: The Dwarves of the Sky Wagon Relic eventually went mad. Can they be saved?
firstStep: The Dwarves who became ghosts and whose dreams were thwarted now wander the Sky Wagon Relic. Pay them your respects. Monsters to Hunt: Forgotten Crewman, Vagabonds of the Ruins

title: Runaway Youth
intro: When you meet a Fisherman's son who ran away because he didn't want to be part of the family business, convince him to return home.
firstStep: You have encountered Ivan, a disturbed youth who ran away from the Fishermen's Guild. You gave him a Scroll of Escape because he regretted what he'd done and wanted to return home. Go and meet with Ivan's father, Batidae, the Fishing Guild Member of the Town of Schuttgart to make sure Ivan is learning his craft well (and that he won't go on anymore...

title: An Aged Ex-Adventurer
intro: The aged ex-adventurer left home for some excitement and found serious trouble. If you encounter him during the adventure, help him out.
firstStep: You met an aged ex-adventurer. The old man had run out of Soulshots in a dangerous hunting ground, and could not travel freely. You shared your Soulshots with him, allowing him to return home. Go to the Town of Oren and meet with Sara, his daughter-in-law, to find out if the old man made it home safely.

title: Wild Maiden
intro: If you meet Suki, who ran away because she fell in love with a vagabond, convince her to go back home.
firstStep: You helped a young woman who had run off with a vagabond. When they broke up, she was lost. Go meet with her father to find out if she made it home safely.

title: Journey to a Settlement
requirement: Completion of the "Last Imperial Prince" quest
intro: The Nameless Spirit at the entrance to the 4th Sepulcher needs somebody to put its double to sleep.
firstStep: The Nameless Spirit informs you that only through the use of a magic scroll can the force field be dispersed. He then informs you that is was created by his "double." Keep listening to the story.

title: A Grand Plan for Taming Wild Beasts
requirement: Clan Leader, Over Clan Level 4, 1hour before the Clan Hall War
intro: The clan that can best tame the wild beasts can obtain a clan hall.
firstStep: Collect 10 Crystals of Purity as proof of your ability to train wild beasts. To acquire the crystals, make sure you stay close to the beasts after taming them. Any member of the same clan may train the now tamed beasts.

title: I'd Rather Be Collecting Fairy Breath
intro: Collect the breath of Wind Sylph, the wind fairy, on Windy Hill.
firstStep: The Head Summoner Galatea thinks that one of the reasons the southern area of Gludio is in ruin is because the balance of fairy energy has been disrupted. She is researching possible causes. Help her efforts by defeating the mad wind fairies on Windy Hill and collecting the last sighs of the fairies. Monsters to Hunt: Sobbing Wind, Babbling Wind, Giggling...

title: Aiding the Floran Village.
intro: The Floran Village is a farmers' commune. The village has been growing, but needs some extra help these days.
firstStep: Floran Village needs help in their fight against their oppressive lord. Meet with Captain Alex in Floran Village.

title: Making the Harvest Grounds Safe
intro: Secure the Fellmere Harvesting Grounds so the masons can work safely.
firstStep: The lord of Gludio Territory is trying to revive his war-torn lands. Fellmere Harvesting Grounds provide vital building supplies for that effort, but the area's monsters are preventing the masons from building a needed plantation there. The lord wants to solve this problem with the help of a brave adventurer. Monsters to Hunt: Giant Poison Bee, Cloudy...

title: A Game of Cards
intro: Warehouse Chief Klump of Aden Castle Town spends most of his time playing cards. The word is that anyone who can beat him will win a generous prize.
firstStep: Warehouse Chief Klump of Aden Castle Town spends most of his time playing cards. The word is that anyone who can beat him will win a generous prize... To enter the game, you must first collect more than 50 Red Gems. Monsters to Hunt: Blazing Swamp: Tulben, Hames Orc Scout, Hames Orc Footman, Cursed Guardian, Hames Orc Overlord Fields of Massacre: Doom...

title: Seductive Whispers
intro: Blacksmith Wilbert of Aden Castle Town is looking for people to play a game very popular among the blacksmiths.
firstStep: Wilbert is willing to play the trendy new game with you, but he tells you that you need Spirit Beads in order to play. Spirit Beads can be obtained at the Cemetery, the Ancient Battleground and the Fields of Massacre. Monsters to Hunt: Spiteful Ghost of Ruins, Soldier of Grief, Cruel Punisher, Roving Soul, Tortured Undead, Wasted Soul, Past Knight, Ghost...

title: Defeat the Elrokian Raiders!
intro: Trader Dinn of the Primeval Isle Wharf is anxious because Elrokian raiders are stealing items from the merchants. He promises to give you a reward if you capture the raiders and bring back their necklaces as proof.
firstStep: Trader Dinn of the Primeval Isle Wharf is anxious because Elrokian raiders are stealing items from the merchants. He promises to give you a reward if you capture the raiders and bring back their necklaces as proof. Monster to Hunt: Elroki
